title: Camp Registration Checklist
subtitle: Capture session placement, cabin group, transportation, and activity support; confirm packing readiness and guardian orientation.
description: Camp Registration records session placement, cabin group, transportation, activity support, packing readiness, and guardian orientation. Camp Registration evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this camp registration stage-gated verification when staff must document session placement and cabin group. Reconcile transportation, activity support, packing readiness, and guardian orientation before the camp registration handoff. Use the placement confirmation, unit roster, bus list, optional-activity choices, support-routing receipt, orientation delivery, and guardian confirmation. This registration establishes seasonal program placement, cabin community, counselor coverage, waterfront or excursion choices, packing readiness, and multi-day guardian release. Ask the assigned camp registration reviewer to confirm session placement against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Camp Registration starting details
sections.guidance: Confirm session capacity, cabin placement, bus choice, packing readiness, activity support, orientation delivery, and guardian handoff.

sections.title: Camp Registration exception review: checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current camp registration facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Camp Registration required checks
items: Session placement is identified for this record
Cabin group matches the current request or source
Transportation is ready for point-of-use staff
Activity support limits or questions are resolved
Packing readiness is communicated to the responsible person
Guardian orientation is confirmed at handoff
A changed camp registration fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Camp Registration failed or pending items

sections.title: Camp Registration exception review and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold camp registration readiness on any failed or pending item.
